1. **Downstream registration form** (opens after "Create Lead >") — referenced in CP-FS §2.3 (10 form fields including T&C, purchase purpose) but no screenshot. Affects TC_023, TC_024, TC_044, TC_045, TC_046, TC_047, TC_049.
2. **Validation error states** for empty/invalid mobile in Create New Lead widget — TC_020, TC_021, TC_022.
3. **"All Team Leads" dropdown — open state** (Lead CP scenario) — TC_034.
4. **Search-filtered table state** — TC_033.
